name: astro-erudite
summary: Unstyled static blog template for Astro: posts, series, authors, RSS — no UI or CSS framework.
description: enscribe's opinionated, unstyled static blogging template built with Astro and native CSS, with no UI framework, no CSS framework and minimal dependencies. Zod-validated content collections handle posts, nested subposts (series), authors, tags and projects; the design system uses Utopia fluid type and space scales and Radix color scales with system dark mode. Includes a scrollspy table of contents, Expressive Code blocks, LaTeX math rendered to MathML, GitHub-style callouts, RSS and a sitemap.
contains: posts, subposts (series), authors, tags and projects as Zod-validated content collections
native-CSS design system with Utopia fluid type/space scales and Radix color scales
system dark mode, with the theme toggle storing an override
table of contents with scrollspy, heading anchors and Expressive Code blocks
LaTeX math rendered to MathML (Temml) and GitHub-style callouts
RSS feed, sitemap and per-post SEO/Open Graph control
23 community example sites built on it
